Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 c_status varchar2(250);
 chk_access boolean;
 
 mc_param_value VALID_PARAMETERS.parameter_value%TYPE;
 l_chapter_id VALID_PARAMETERS.chapter_id%TYPE;
 dtLocalDate DATE:= get_local_date;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin

 /* If there are any changes then commit the form */

 if :system.form_status='CHANGED' then
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 first_record;
 loop
 -- message('Rec status='||:system.record_status ||' inter='||:exist_inter_blk.inter_code);pause;
 if :system.record_status in ('INSERT') then
 if :exist_inter_blk.inter_code is null then
 show_error('0080');
 end if;

 chk_access := don_common_pack.is_access_allowed(:banner.user_id,'PROPR',:exist_inter_blk.inter_code);
 if not chk_access then
 show_error('18033');
 end if;

 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 02/27/2012. IM 7078
 --MS Added this validation check as per Edwin.
 Select parameter_value 
 into mc_param_value 
 from valid_parameters 
 where parameter_code = 'MULTI_CHAP' 
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id 
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); --- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1);

 if mc_param_value = 'Y' then
 l_chapter_id := 'ALL';
 else
 l_chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 end if;
 
 --MS
 -- End of commented section */
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 02/27/2012. IM 7078
 if IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 l_chapter_id := 'ALL';
 :exist_inter_blk.chapter_id := 'ALL'; -- Added by Kishore on 08/17/2015. IM 66
 else
 l_chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 :exist_inter_blk.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id; -- Added by Kishore on 08/17/2015. IM 66
 end if;
 -- End of change


 -- AV; 06/06/2012; IM: 8705
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 ---
 don_inter.inter_upgrade_place(:ctrl.donor_id,
 --:global.chapter_id,
 l_chapter_id,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :exist_inter_blk.inter_code,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.user_id,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.prog_name,
 trunc(chp_sysdate), -- trunc(sysdate), -- IM: 8705
 :exist_inter_blk.term_date,
 NULL,
 c_status) ;
 
 if c_status!='OK' then
 message('Error:'||c_status);
 pause;
 end if;
 :ctrl.temp_term_date:=:exist_inter_blk.term_date;
 :ctrl.temp_eff_date:=:exist_inter_blk.eff_date;
 :ctrl.temp_inter_code:=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code;
 
 clear_record;
 --message(:ctrl.temp_inter_code||' '||to_Char(:ctrl.temp_eff_date)||' '||to_char(:ctrl.temp_term_date));pause;
 
 update donor_interdictions set term_date=nvl(term_date,:ctrl.temp_term_date) where
 donor_id=:ctrl.donor_id and inter_code=:ctrl.temp_inter_code and eff_date=:ctrl.temp_eff_date and
 program_id='DPWPROPR'; 
 
 
 end if;
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 
 If :system.record_status ='INSERT' then 
 don_inter.inter_upgrade_place(:ctrl.donor_id,
 --:global.chapter_id,
 l_chapter_id,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :exist_inter_blk.inter_code,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.user_id,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.prog_name,
 trunc(chp_sysdate), -- trunc(sysdate), -- IM: 8705
 :exist_inter_blk.term_date,
 NULL,
 c_status) ;
 
 if c_status!='OK' then
 message('Error:'||c_status);
 pause;
 end if;
 :ctrl.temp_term_date:=:exist_inter_blk.term_date;
 :ctrl.temp_eff_date:=:exist_inter_blk.eff_date;
 :ctrl.temp_inter_code:=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code;
 
 clear_record;
 --- message('Last record='||:ctrl.temp_inter_code||' '||to_Char(:ctrl.temp_eff_date)||' '||to_char(:ctrl.temp_term_date));pause;
 
 update donor_interdictions set term_date=nvl(term_date,:ctrl.temp_term_date) where
 donor_id=:ctrl.donor_id and inter_code=:ctrl.temp_inter_code and eff_date=:ctrl.temp_eff_date and
 program_id='DPWPROPR'; 
 End If;
 
 exit;
 Else
 
 if :system.record_status in ('CHANGED','QUERY') then 
 next_record;
 end if;
 null; 
 End if;
 
 end loop;
 
 --commit; -- Commented by Kishore on 05/07/2015. IM 22
 post; -- Added by Kishore on 05/07/2015. IM 22
 forms_ddl('commit'); -- Added by Kishore on 05/07/2015. IM 22

 if :system.form_status='QUERY' then
 show_error('9163'); /* Transaction Committed */
 end if;
 end if;
 /* Go the existing properties block */
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 execute_query;
 check_terminated;
 
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then Null;
 when others then 
 message(SQlerrm);
 handle_error;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 descr varchar2(50);
 dtLocalDate date := get_local_date; -- IM5237

 /* Cursor to select terminated Properties */

 --cursor c1 is -- IM5237
 cursor c1(vdate in date) is
 select inter_code,
 inter_type,
 eff_date,
 term_date,
 insert_user
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select b.access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes b,valid_user_access_classes a 
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and vdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,vdate+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='PROPR'
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- IM5237
 and vdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,vdate+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 --and term_date<sysdate; -- IM5237
 and term_date<vdate;
 

begin
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 go_block('term_inter_blk');
 --for z in c1 --IM5237
 for z in c1(dtLocalDate)
 loop
 select inter_desc
 into descr
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=z.inter_code; 
 
 :term_inter_blk.inter_code := z.inter_code;
 :term_inter_blk.eff_date := to_char(z.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 :term_inter_blk.term_date := to_char(z.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 :term_inter_blk.descrip := descr;
 :term_inter_blk.insert_user := z.insert_user;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 delete_record;
 first_record; 
 
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 
 /* set_item_property('ctrl.remove_prop',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);*/
 set_item_property('ctrl.save',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl.term_prop',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl.close',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl.note',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_TERM_ALLOWED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_TERM_ALLOWED(c_user_id varchar2,c_code_type varchar2,c_code varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
c_view_level number;
c_inter_level number := NULL;
chk_all number;
dtLocalDate Date := get_local_date;

BEGIN

 /* Check whether user has ALL access */

 /* check whether the given code and type has been defined in one of
 the access classes of the user */
 
 begin
 select max(b.inter_level)
 into c_inter_level
 from valid_acl_codes a , valid_user_access_classes b
 where b.user_id = c_user_id
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and dtLocaldate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and a.access_class=b.access_class
 and a.access_code_type=c_code_type
 --and a.access_code_value = 'ALL'
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1); -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,dtLocalDate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 NULL ;
 end;
 if c_inter_level is null then

 begin
 select max(b.inter_level)
 into c_inter_level
 from valid_acl_codes a , valid_user_access_classes b
 where b.user_id = c_user_id
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and a.access_class=b.access_class
 and a.access_code_type=c_code_type
 and a.access_code_value = c_code
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1); -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,dtLocalDate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 return FALSE ;
 end;
 end if;

 if c_code_type='PROPR' then
 begin
 select view_level
 into c_view_level
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=c_code
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR');
 
 if c_view_level < c_inter_level then
 return TRUE;
 else
 return FALSE;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 return FALSE;
 end;
 end if;

END;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS

 c_dob date;
 c_ssn varchar2(12);
 c_abo varchar2(5);
 other_propr1 number:=0;
 other_propr2 number:=0;
 chk_all number :=0;
 c_term_cnt number :=0;
 c_title varchar2(300);
 
 dtLocalDate date := get_local_date; -- IM5237

 szSSNMode NUMBER;
 
BEGIN

 --:global.program_version := '1.01.02';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.01';
 
 --:global.program_version := '02'; -- LifeTrak3.4.0 release, 4 digit SSN change
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- LifeTrak 3.4.0 - Displays the five leading zeros in the SSN even when the value is null
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- IM 2174

 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- Replaced WAD' with :global.chapter_id--01/20/11

 --:global.program_version := '08'; -- MS (IM# 4907). Removed the condition chapter_id = :global.chapter_id from PRE-QUERY trigger in exist_inter_blk block, to pull all the attributes irrespective of user's logged-in chapter.
 --:global.program_version := '09'; -- MS (IM# 5237) & Time Zone related changes

 --:global.program_version := '11'; -- IM 7078

 --:global.program_version := '13'; -- IM 8705; Added synchronize builtin.
 --:global.program_version := '14'; -- IM: 8705; Added shynchronize builtin and show_view, hide_view builtins. 
 -- Also, don_inter.upgrade_place routine modified to pass chapter time instead of server time. 
 --:global.program_version := '15'; -- IM:8497
 --:global.program_version := '16'; -- IM 9775

 --:global.program_version := '19'; -- IM 22

 --:global.program_version := '21'; -- IM 66
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 -- :global.program_version := '01'; 
 -- :global.program_version := '02'; --- MLT- 1636
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- MLT 4414
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- MLT 6273
 -- :global.program_version := '05'; -- MLT 6309
 :global.program_version := '06'; -- MLT 7981
 
 :system.message_level :=10;
 /**
 :PARAMETER.P_donor_id := 'DN00000331' ;
 :PARAMETER.P_chapter_id := 'WAD' ;
 **/



 if :PARAMETER.P_donor_id is not null and

 set_window_property('WIN0',TITLE,c_title);
 go_block('CTRL');
 :ctrl.donor_id:= :PARAMETER.p_donor_id;
 
 --begin
 
 begin
 select to_char(date_of_birth,'MM-DD-YYYY'),
 ssn,
 nvl(blood_type,'NONE'),
 decode(gender,'M','Male','F','Female'),
 initcap(ltrim(rtrim(last_name)))||', '||
 initcap(ltrim(rtrim(first_name)))||' '||initcap(ltrim(rtrim(middle_name)))
 into 
 :ctrl.date_of_birth,
 c_ssn,
 c_abo,
 :ctrl.gender,
 :ctrl.name
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl.donor_id;
 exception

 When Others Then Handle_Error;
 
 end; 


 /*select the blood type description from valid_mster_codes */
 begin

 into :ctrl.blood_type

 where code_type='ABO'
 and code=c_abo;

 end;
 
 /* other attributes which are not part of the classes of the current user */
 begin
 select distinct 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR'
 --and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 -- and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) -- IM 5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1))
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1);

 end;

 if chk_all=1 then
 
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :ctrl.other_propr
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237 
 and dtLocalDate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='PROPR'
 --and b.access_code_value='ALL'
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and c.view_level>a.inter_level
 --and sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,dtLocalDate+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1);
 exception
 When no_data_found Then Null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 

 else
 /* Calculate the no of interdictions which doesn't belong to the
 users access classes */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into other_propr1
 from donor_interdictions 
 where donor_id = :ctrl.donor_id
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR' 
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1))
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1)) 
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1);

 exception
 When no_data_found Then Null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /*Calculate the no of interdictions placed on the donor but he user
 doesn't have access to remove */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into other_propr2
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='PROPR'
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and b.access_code_value=c.inter_code
 and c.view_level>a.inter_level
 --and sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,dtLocalDate+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,dtLocalDate+1);
 exception
 When no_data_found Then Null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 :ctrl.other_propr := other_propr1+other_propr2;
 
 end if; 


 if :ctrl.other_propr>0 then
 :ctrl.note := 'NOTE: There are other attributes on this donor.';
 end if;
 
 begin 
 select nvl(count(*),0)
 into c_term_cnt
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select b.access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes b,valid_user_access_classes a 
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,dtLocalDate+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='PROPR'
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- IM5237
 and dtLocalDate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,dtLocalDate+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 --and term_date<sysdate; -- IM5237
 and term_date<dtLocalDate;
 exception
 When no_data_found Then Null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 if c_term_cnt=0 then
 set_item_property('ctrl.term_prop',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end if;
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 execute_query;
 SYNCHRONIZE; -- IM:8705;
 
 else
 message('ERR: Required parameter missing');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 
 
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 HANDLE_ERROR; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUNOTHER_FORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUNOTHER_FORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM ( p_exec_name);
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

 and dtLocalDate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,dtLocalDate+1))
 and inter_type in (select code

 --and term_date<sysdate; -- IM5237

 end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE

FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;
